name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for ssgrep
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what's stopping you today? Describe the
underlying problem, not just the requested solution — it's easier to
evaluate alternatives that way.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen. If you have a specific CLI surface, flag, or
behavior in mind, describe it — example commands/output are especially
useful.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you've thought about, including workarounds you're
using today.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps evaluate this — how often you'd use it, whether it
overlaps with existing functionality, links to related issues, etc.
